ERROR: failed to solve: process "/bin/sh -c DUCKDB_EXTENSION_DIR=/app/.duckdb-extensions node /tmp/install-duckdb-extensions.mjs     && chown -R nao:nao /app/.duckdb-extensions" did not complete successfully: exit code: 1
I'll inspect the DuckDB extension install step in the Docker build and the script it runs.
I'll reproduce the install script failure and check how DuckDB expects `extension_directory` to be configured.
Likely module resolution: the script is bind-mounted under `/tmp`, so Node won't see `/app/node_modules`. Verifying that.

cd /tmp/duckdb-resolve-test && DUCKDB_EXTENSION_DIR=/tmp/test-duckdb-exts2 node /tmp/duckdb-resolve-test/install.mjs 2>&1 | head -40; echo "---"; # With NODE_PATH pointing at project
cd /tmp/duckdb-resolve-test && NODE_PATH=/Users/blef/Work/naolabs/chat/node_modules DUCKDB_EXTENSION_DIR=/tmp/test-duckdb-exts2 node /tmp/duckdb-resolve-test/install.mjs 2>&1 | head -40

content.text: Confirmed: the script is mounted at `/tmp`, so Node never finds `/app/node_modules`. Mounting it under `/app` instead.

input.new_string:
# Mount under /app so Node's ESM resolver finds /app/node_modules (a /tmp mount would not).
RUN --mount=type=bind,source=docker/install-duckdb-extensions.mjs,target=/app/install-duckdb-extensions.mjs \
    DUCKDB_EXTENSION_DIR=/app/.duckdb-extensions node /app/install-duckdb-extensions.mjs \
    && chown -R nao:nao /app/.duckdb-extensions \
    && rm -f /app/install-duckdb-extensions.mjs

content.text: Bind mounts don't persist in the image layer, so the `rm` is unnecessary — removing it.

content.text:
The install script was bind-mounted at `/tmp/...`, so Node’s ESM resolver never walked into `/app/node_modules` and failed with `Cannot find package '@duckdb/node-api'`.

It’s now mounted at `/app/install-duckdb-extensions.mjs` so resolution finds the deps. Re-run the Docker build and that step should pass.
